new_defects.what_is_wrong: No proof of the contract names this file, whose live-error construction changed from a hand-built array (splice public_safety at index 1, push language_policy at the end) to a Map walked in CLOSEOUT_PHASE_IDS order. The order is equal to the base in every combination of required detectors today (case analysis in review.md section 2), but no test in proof 10's regression set would fail if the order changed: the only proof-10 file touching it asserts with toContain, and my order mutant (walking liveDetectorFindings.keys() instead) stayed GREEN across all nine files, 149/149 passed, exit 0. A future order regression would be caught by no proof 1-11.

The Out of scope paragraph names prepare.ts's per-family root-debt blocks, its three literal detector ids and the completion-debt order, but does not name two sites the DEV report (section 6, items 4 and 5) records as left alone: prepare.ts's five bundle result file names (prepare.ts:249-355, a second copy of the registry's bundleFile values) and the spec.id input-kind ternaries/ifs in bundle-detector-evidence.ts:569-667 plus the policy filter in detector-coverage.ts. Both were surfaced to the PM in the report, so nothing is hidden, but the contract's recorded obligations are incomplete on them. Not a behaviour change.

The proof titles are stronger than the mechanisms. Proof 1's scanner flags array/tuple/Set literals only; a second list written as an object keyed by family ids passes (documented negative at line 319), as do runtime-joined string consts. Proof 3's scanner flags else-if chains only in four files; a switch statement or a sequence of plain ifs on a family id passes (documented negative at line 379). The contract's criteria text describes exactly these mechanisms, test (c) adds the satisfies Record<PhaseId, compiler guard at all four sites, and proof 4's differential covers reachable paths - so the criteria hold as written; the titles ('the registry is the only place that lists family ids', 'no chain of family comparisons is left at the named sites') should be read with these limits.

The proof-12 summary (SJ-ROOT/s2d/selfjudge/evidence-proof-12.txt line 2) describes the run as the docker line of RUN.txt with nice -n 10, but RUN.txt's docker line carries no nice -n 10 (grep over RUN.txt, judge.sh, judge.log and run-times.txt finds that string only in the summary itself), and RUN.txt still ends with the stale comment # NOT STARTED: waits for the Mac queue although judge.log and run-times.txt show the run completed 2026-11-17T07:15:52Z to 07:24:10Z rc=0. The run folder does not record the exact command that ran. The outcome records (judge.sh, judge.log, run-times.txt, prepare.out, prepare.err, out/mister-clean/mg-s2d-selfjudge-1/) are mutually consistent, so no criterion of proof 12 is affected.
